entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Dated: 16/08/2023 Mr. A.K. Kashyap, learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that the wife of respondent no. 2 namely, Vasudha Gupta has lodged F.I.R. bearing No. 14/2021 under section 498A I.P.C. and other sections of the I.P.C. against the respondent no. 2 and his family members which was settled later on.

He submits that in the present case allegations are made that the petitioners who happen to be the father-in-law and brother-in-law respectively hatched conspiracy against the respondent no.2 and apart from that there is nothing against the petitioners.

2. Let notice be issued upon the respondent no. 2 under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks.
3.
Till the next date, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners in connection with Taljhari P.S. Case No. 40 of 2022, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M. at Dumka.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/
